exposure: no medication for opioid use disorder
outcome: Quantity of opioids prescribed at discharge
cohort: Pregnant patients who delivered at >20 weeks' gestation at a tertiary academic hospital between May 2014 and April 2020.
finding: Patients with OUD consumed significantly greater quantities of opioids after cesarean delivery but received fewer opioid prescriptions at discharge compared to opioid-naïve patients.
mod_finding: Patients with OUD consumed significantly more opioids after cesarean delivery compared to opioid-naïve patients, but there was no difference in opioid consumption after vaginal delivery.
